title: Odessia Launches AI Travel Agent with Exclusive Agency Rates
summary:
Travelers can now use a text-based AI assistant to secure hotel upgrades, breakfast perks and loyalty discounts typically reserved for professional agents. Odessia, a Sequoia-backed startup, has launched an accredited AI travel agent that books flights and accommodation using its official agency status to bypass public pricing. The tool ranks hundreds of thousands of hotels across 12 specific dimensions, such as gym equipment and street noise, and allows users to execute entire trip bookings through a single text message.

The service utilizes persistent memory and scheduled tasks to monitor for price drops or cancellations after a user's initial request. Founder F. Davidson describes the free tool as a "cheat code" for a crowded leisure economy and predicts that the arrival of artificial general intelligence within months will further disrupt the industry. The agent currently provides live monitoring for restaurant tables and show tickets in addition to traditional travel arrangements.
